evidence.title: Munder Difflin – Agent harness to run an office of your clones

summary: Munder Difflin introduced a new AI tool called 'Agent Harness' designed to generate and oversee digital clones to automate office tasks. The system aims to streamline workflows by delegating repetitive or administrative duties to AI-powered replicas.
title: Munder Difflin Unveils AI Agent Harness to Create and Manage Digital Clones for Office Work
